title: When loneliness closes the room in in the day as it is
issueStatement: The heart feels unaccompanied even when people are nearby. The pressure is not abstract anymore; it is meeting the ordinary shape of the day.
centralInsight: Guru joins belonging to remembrance, Sangat, and the nearness of the One. Gurbani refuses to treat the ordinary day as spiritually irrelevant.
practicalReflection: Neediness is not rejected here. It is brought honestly into the Guru's care. Name the companionship the line is restoring before the mind insists it is alone.
actionPrompt: Name the companionship the line is restoring before the mind insists it is alone. Keep the response small enough to survive an ordinary day.
